universal_patterns.pattern: any (?:individual|person) licensed or certified by a board under this article
in this article the following words
list of the names of each unit that issues a license under this title

proposal.rationale: Title 2.5 of the Business Regulation Article (Service Members, Veterans, and Military Spouses -- Licensing) applies universally to ALL licensing units across the state — it's a cross-cutting umbrella title that grants expedited licensing, credit for military experience, and renewal accommodations to every licensing board/unit. The sections repeatedly use "each unit shall" and "a unit may" referring to any unit "authorized to issue a license" (per the 2.5-101 definition). I've added universal patterns to catch these title-wide directives: "each unit shall", "a unit may ... license", references to service member/veteran/military spouse triads, and the explicit "list of the names of each unit that issues a license under this title" language. These mark Title 2.5 sections as title-wide universal. Other patterns remain as before for the Health Occupations Article umbrella.
